switching.scope: Three repeats, all3seeds, six original candidates, latency1pp. Mode-matched eager/graph controls; no test-based tuning. Compare only matchingpool/configuration.
switching.payback_scope: Seed-specific TinyCNN GPUfit-only numerator, positive matchedGPUinferencesaving denominator, allrepeataccuracygate. Excludes CPU,supervision,calibration,export,startup. Training/inference separate sessions; measurements straddle saved recovery, notwholePC energy.
switching.limitations: Three repeats are descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals. Sequential caseorders/sessionthermals may affect differences: eligible-eager timings varied substantially across repeats/sessions. All host-aware cases collapsed to the same staticR101FP16; faster same-classifier measurements are not proof of dynamic-selection benefit. Keep rawcoldloads/setup separate; resident warm inference excludes pool startup.

fit_energy.scope: GPU only; gross NVML counter difference including idle/display; not whole-PC
fit_energy.boundary: CUDA context/data validation before measurement; initialization, 20 fit epochs, atomic epoch checkpoint writes inside fit window. Final weights write, calibration, export and supervision generation excluded.

supervision.note: Seed42 only, one repeat per predeclared case; no test-based policy selection. Six original resident eager classifiers, GPU-only energy excludes CPU/restPC. Preserve accuracy failures and negative savings. Separate-session timing variation prevents a general causal speedup claim. Fit payback must use the corresponding fit energy and positive savings plus accuracy compliance.

supervision_payback.scope: GPU fit only; init/checkpoints/internal tune included where used; supervision/calibration/export/CPU excluded. Separate training/inference sessions; descriptive estimates, not precise uncertainty.

note: Historical 213-choice/capacity2 vs new six-resident classifiers are not a matched batch-size experiment. No inference reruns.
